Specification: This module is a driver-style TLA+ specification that invokes TLC externally to run simulation experiments for another specification, Calculator.tla, using IOUtils and TLC environment access. It defines command-line argument sequences for a baseline simulator run and for reinforcement-learning-enabled simulator runs, then uses ASSUME statements to execute those commands and report success or errors via PrintT and Print. The file does not model the calculator algorithm itself as state variables and actions; instead it orchestrates tool execution, collects the TLC revision tag, iterates over a finite set of reward values, and uses CASE distinctions on process exit codes to assert successful runs.
AssumptionNames:
LET ret == IOEnvExec([R |-> -1, N |-> N], Cmd).exitValue
    IN CASE ret =  0 -> PrintT("baseline")
         [] OTHER    -> Print(<<IOEnvExec([R |-> -1, N |-> N], Cmd), "Error">>, FALSE)

\A reward \in { -200, -100, -10, -1, 0, 1, 10, 100 }:
    LET ret == IOEnvExec([N |-> N, R |-> reward], RLCmd).exitValue
    IN CASE ret =  0 -> PrintT(reward)
         [] OTHER    -> Print(<<reward, IOEnvExec([N |-> N, R |-> reward], RLCmd), "Error">>, FALSE)
CaseExpr: CASE ret = 0 -> PrintT("baseline") [] OTHER -> Print(<<IOEnvExec([R |-> -1, N |-> N], Cmd), "Error">>, FALSE)
CASE ret = 0 -> PrintT(reward) [] OTHER -> Print(<<reward, IOEnvExec([N |-> N, R |-> reward], RLCmd), "Error">>, FALSE)
FunctionApplication: Print(<<reward, IOEnvExec([N |-> N, R |-> reward], RLCmd), "Error">>, FALSE)
